import re


def slugify(title):
    title = title.lower()
    title = title.replace("&", " and ")
    title = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 -]", "", title)
    title = re.sub(r"[ -]+", "-", title)
    title = title.strip("-")
    if len(title) > 40:
        title = title[:40].rstrip("-")
    return title
